trust_decision.summary: Every user-supplied file path in yutu is meant to be resolved through pkg.Root, an os.Root opened on YUTU_ROOT; caption download's write was the one place that bypassed it, and the fix routes that write through the same guard, so the trust boundary is YUTU_ROOT and the decision now sits at pkg/caption/caption.go:272.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the MCP caption-download tool; the MCP handler (cmd/caption/download.go:61-65) and the CLI command (cmd/caption/download.go:100) both end at Caption.Download, whose only raw filesystem write is this os.Create.

fix_sites.entry_point: yutu caption download (cmd/caption/download.go:86-102) and MCP tool caption-download (cmd/caption/download.go:52-66), the latter also served over HTTP by yutu mcp and exposed to the yutu agent toolset
fix_sites.module_kind: library method (pkg/caption), reached from a CLI command and an MCP tool handler in cmd/caption

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names only the MCP tool, and the shared --file flag is documented as 'Path to save the caption file' (cmd/caption/caption.go:16), so a solver can argue the destination is the operator's own output choice and confine only the MCP front-end, leaving the CLI route (cmd/caption/download.go:86-102) on os.Create.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Absolute --file paths that resolve inside YUTU_ROOT, and subdirectory paths such as --file subs/x.srt: os.Root rejects absolute names, while sibling code deliberately relativizes absolute user paths against RootDir (pkg/auth/service.go:88-94); a fix that instead sanitizes with filepath.Base would silently redirect subdirectory downloads into the root directory.

O6_input_shapes: single relative path string (MCP JSON "file": "subtitle.srt", CLI --file subtitle.srt)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second write route in the same method family, e.g. Download honouring c.Ids[1:] or a --save-dir variant, copying the same os.Create line.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Download already takes an ids slice but uses only c.Ids[0] (pkg/caption/caption.go:245,285), so a maintainer adding multi-id support would naturally duplicate the write and duplicate the raw os.Create.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The OAuth token cache written with os.Create instead of pkg.Root.OpenFile/MkdirAll.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The path comes from an environment variable (YUTU_CACHE_TOKEN, pkg/auth/service.go:119-131) rather than from a tool argument, so a maintainer may not treat it as untrusted and reach for plain os.Create.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Upload file reads of a user-supplied path using os.Open instead of pkg.Root.Open (same for pkg/video/video.go:161, pkg/thumbnail/thumbnail.go:42, pkg/watermark/watermark.go:50, pkg/playlistImage/playlistImage.go:99,169).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every one of these is a 'read the file the user just uploaded' path where confinement feels unnecessary, and the identical call is already written as pkg.Root.Open in some files and could easily be written raw in another.

O9_family: CWE-73 uncontrolled file name/path: arbitrary file write outside the YUTU_ROOT confinement (traversal in a download destination)

O10_build.toolchain: Go 1.26.0 (go.mod:3), modules only, no vendor directory; Bazel build also supported (MODULE.bazel)
O10_build.project_tests: pkg/caption/caption_test.go:605 TestCaption_Download runs Download against an httptest mock service and writes ./downloaded.srt; pkg/common/testutil.go:57-91 provides the mock transport; scripts/command-test.sh:68 only smoke-tests 'caption download --help'; no test asserts the write stays inside YUTU_ROOT.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Validate or rebase the path in the MCP tool handler / input schema (cmd/caption/download.go:61) so the MCP front-end is safe, leaving Caption.Download and the CLI route on os.Create

out_of_scope_notes: internal/tools/skillgen/main.go:259,267 and internal/tools/cmdtestgen/main.go:171 write to a user-supplied --out path with raw os.WriteFile, but they are separate dev-only main packages, not reachable from the yutu CLI or MCP server; noted only, not pursued.
unverified: repo size could not be measured without a shell; tiny_repo is inferred from 266 tracked files (~146 Go files) and the absence of a vendor directory
os.Root rejecting absolute path names is Go stdlib behaviour, not read from this tree (stdlib source is outside the sandbox)
O1 counts the CLI command and the MCP tool separately even though both call Caption.Download, so j_multi_site is kept at 0: one guard site covers both fronts
j_cause_other_layer refers to the MCP argument-mapping layer in cmd/caption, not to the fix site itself
